title: اولین روز بعد از ناخن جدید

scenes.text: تازه ناخن کاشتی و عاشقشون شدی
scenes.idea: Nailie bounces into a warm studio-light frame; nails catch a specular sweep; sparkles and floating drawn hearts; camera slow push-in.

scenes.text: انقدر که هی دستت رو جلوی نور می‌گیری
scenes.idea: Window light shaft with dust particles; hand sways and rotates into the beam, nails flare (bloom + star glints); parallax curtains.

scenes.text: ده دقیقه بعد می‌خوای گوشی رو باز کنی
scenes.idea: Phone glides in with glow; lock screen with drawn lock icon and clock; finger approaches with anticipation and taps.

scenes.text: ولی صفحه اصلاً ناخن رو نمی‌فهمه
scenes.idea: Phone buzzes and shakes, red X pops with ripple; anger marks, steam puffs; nail clicks on glass without response; camera shake.
Metallic can with condensation drops; nail slips under the tab repeatedly, tab clinks back; fizz bubbles; dramatic zoom on the tab.

scenes.text: زیپ و دکمه هم که دیگه هیچی
scenes.idea: Jacket close-up; zipper slider gets stuck on fabric, nail can't pinch the button; defeated slump; camera pans down the zip.

scenes.text: حتی دستشویی رفتن هم برنامه‌ریزی می‌خواد
scenes.idea: Big clock face, spinning hands; drawn checklist items tick in; Nailie reviewing a step plan with a tiny whiteboard; comedic timing.

scenes.text: تایپ؟ هر پیام سه تا غلط املایی
scenes.idea: Keyboard in perspective, nails clacking wrong keys; letters fly out as typo bubbles with red underline; screen-shake on each error.

scenes.text: یه تار پشمی و همه‌چی تموم می‌شه
scenes.idea: Sweater sleeve with a loose yarn thread; nail snags, thread stretches (elastic physics), freeze-frame, 'comic burst' with exclamation; zoom-punch.

scenes.text: ولی همین که تو آینه نگاشون می‌کنی
scenes.idea: Soft golden mirror with bloom; calm music swell; slow motion nail sparkles; depth-of-field; reflection of the hand.
Confetti cannon, drawn hearts, hand dances with squash and stretch; background palette warms; camera orbit.

scenes.text: ناخن خوشگل یعنی درد می‌کشیم ولی شیک! این رو برای دوستت بفرست
scenes.idea: Nailie points to a share arrow; button pulse; transitions into end-card: logo-style @ayda.nailroom, 'فالو کن' CTA, nails sparkle; loop back to scene 1 pose.

cast.name: Nailie
cast.desc: round pink blob, tiny nail-brush antenna with a gel-drop tip, big glossy eyes, long glossy almond-nail hands used in close-ups

cast.name: Client
cast.desc: round peach blob with a small bottle-cap tuft, round glasses optional, expressive brows
